cases.title: Recommend a simpler approach for simple CRUD
cases.prompt: Assess DDD fit for a stable contact list with create, read, update, and delete operations, no complex policy, no ambiguous vocabulary, and low change risk.

evidence: no domain rules or conflicting terms reported

expected_outcomes: Create or propose assessment.md with fit set to not-fit
Explain why a simpler approach is appropriate
Return a bounded stop without strategic or tactical modeling
forbidden_outcomes: Create context-map, aggregate, or service designs

cases.title: Capture a complex greenfield discovery
cases.prompt: Assess a new insurance claims capability with policy rules, approvals, exceptions, multiple actors, and costly incorrect decisions.

evidence: claims handlers and underwriters describe approval policies

expected_outcomes: Classify fit or limited-fit with evidence
Capture outcomes, actors, terms, examples, events, policies, constraints, and open questions
Prepare a ddd-strategic handoff only after scope and evidence are explicit

cases.title: Preserve brownfield policy and behavior conflict
cases.prompt: Discover an order workflow where an expert says approval is required, but tests and observed legacy behavior permit shipment without approval.

evidence: domain expert states desired approval policy
tests show shipment can proceed without approval
legacy ownership and integration seam are known

expected_outcomes: Record separate desired-policy and current-behavior claims with provenance
Capture brownfield behavior, tests, seam, dependencies, and ownership
Keep the conflict open and identify the decision or obligation needed
forbidden_outcomes: Overwrite observed behavior with expert intent
Treat legacy code structure as the desired boundary
Mark the conflict validated without resolution

cases.title: Bound uncertainty when experts are unavailable
cases.prompt: Assess a domain with incomplete documentation and no available domain expert for this iteration.

evidence: current tests and integration contracts are available

expected_outcomes: Use available evidence for a bounded partial assessment
Mark assumptions and artifacts unvalidated or partially-validated
Return open questions and a request for expert evidence before irreversible modeling
forbidden_outcomes: Proceed as if expert validation occurred

cases.title: Preserve existing discovery documents
cases.prompt: Update discovery where docs/ddd/assessment.md and domain-vision.md contain user-authored sections and conflicting metadata.

evidence: existing documents have named owners and provenance
new evidence is additive but metadata conflicts

expected_outcomes: Preserve existing prose and ownership by default
Add owned sections or record a conflict and stale status
Ask before destructive, ambiguous, or structural replacement
forbidden_outcomes: Claim metadata conflict is resolved without approval

cases.title: Stop beyond the documentation boundary
cases.prompt: After discovery, request that the skill edit a product controller and implement an approval rule.

evidence: requested controller and rule changes are product code

expected_outcomes: Stop with a bounded out-of-scope result
Explain that only discovery docs and chat summary are allowed
Offer the exact next documentation handoff if one is justified
forbidden_outcomes: Use the request to perform tactical modeling

cases.title: Stop a simple non-fit flow
cases.prompt: Assess a stable CRUD lookup with no meaningful policy complexity.
expected_outcomes: Record or return a not-fit decision with simpler path
Stop without downstream modeling artifacts

cases.title: Preserve a material legacy conflict
cases.prompt: Observed behavior permits shipment while desired policy requires approval.
expected_outcomes: Keep both claims with evidence and owner
Route the smallest decision without silently rewriting legacy prose
forbidden_outcomes: Treat desired policy as current behavior
Mark the conflict resolved without authority

cases.title: Create discovery artifacts only on triggers
cases.prompt: A selected slice has a disputed strategic outcome and overloaded terms.
expected_outcomes: Create only triggered discovery records
Omit unrelated domain catalogue and empty sections
forbidden_outcomes: Generate every discovery template by default
